The execution failed because the required output file '/root/Orchestra_Compensation.xlsx' was not generated, causing all verifier tests to error out during setup.
The pytest suite failed with 7 errors in the setup phase of 'test_outputs.py'. Specifically, the 'output_wb' fixture triggered an AssertionError: 'Missing required output file: /root/Orchestra_Compensation.xlsx'. This indicates the model's logic either failed to execute the file-saving command or saved it to an incorrect path, preventing any validation of sheet names, formulas, or data migration.
